==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alter|en|comptrol|comptroll|controll|controul|countrol||obsolete}} * {{alter|en|Ctrl||abbreviation|computing}} ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|:inh|enm:controllen|text=++|tree=+}} Partly displaced native {{ncog|ang|wealdan}} and {{ncog|ang|wieldan}}, whence their merged reflex {{ncog|en|wield}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɹəʊl/|[kənˈtɹɒʊl]|/kənˈtɹɒl/|a=RP|a3=doll-dole}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-control.wav|a=Southern England}} * {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɹoʊl/|a=US}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-control.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɹəʉl/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɹɐʉl/|a=NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɾol/|a=Scotland}} * {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɾoːl/|a=Wales,non-toe-tow}} * {{rhymes|en|əʊl|s=2}} * {{hyphenation|en|con|trol}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb|++}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To exercise [[influence]] over; to [[suggest]] or [[dictate]] the behavior of. #: {{syn|en|besteer|bewield|manage|puppeteer|rule|govern|hold sway}} #: {{ux|en|With a simple remote, he could '''control''' the toy truck.}} #* {{quote-journal |en |date=2011-03-01 |author=Phil McNulty |title=Chelsea 2 - 1 Man Utd |work=w:BBC |url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/9405635.stm |page= |passage=This was a wonderful advert for the Premier League, with both Chelsea and United intent on all-out attack - but Ferguson will be concerned at how his side lost their way after imperiously '''controlling''' much of the first period.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260411234226/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/eng_prem/9405635.stm|archivedate=11 April 2026}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-05-17 |author=w:George Monbiot|title=Money just makes the rich suffer |volume=188|issue=23|page=19 |magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/may/06/politics-envy-keenest-rich |passage=In order to grant the rich these pleasures, the social contract is reconfigured. […]  The public realm is privatised, the regulations restraining the ultra–wealthy and the companies they '''control''' are abandoned, and Edwardian levels of inequality are almost fetishised.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261011071319/https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/may/06/politics-envy-keenest-rich|archivedate=11 October 2026}} # {{lb|en|transitive|statistics}} (''construed with'' [[for]]) To [[design]] (an [[experiment]]) so that the [[effect]]s of one or more [[variables]] are [[reduce]]d or [[eliminate]]d. # {{lb|en|transitive|archaic}} To [[verify]] the [[accuracy]] of (something or someone, especially a financial account) by [[comparison]] with another [[account]]. # {{lb|en|transitive|obsolete}} To [[call to account]], to [[take to task]], to [[challenge]]. #* {{RQ:Skelton Complete|Hauke|64|lines=94–99|I fortuned to come in,
Thys rebell to behold,
